system.description:
Standard: You give orders to your crewmates. When a willing crewmember needs to add or switch a crew position while under pressure or in danger, you can mark a Stress to allow them to do so without marking Stress themselves.

Dedicated: You can lead a barrage against a target that has the Lock On condition. Mark a Stress and burn the Lock On to make an Action Roll against the target without gaining the normal d6 for burning the Lock On. On a success, choose up to two Gunners or Systems Operators on your vehicle. Each chosen character may immediately make an attack against the target or use a system against the target. If this requires a roll, it is a Reaction Roll. Damage from each weapon that hits is applied separately.
